fields.Intake — Published:
240 standard MBA seats; separate MBA Business Analytics 30 and Healthcare/Hospital Management 30 excluded.
Published numeric intake: 240
fields.Fees — Published: ₹4.95 lakh gross: ₹2.50 lakh year 1 + ₹2.45 lakh year 2, including ₹5,000 security. Both code-132 and code-272 official fee URLs show this schedule; code-272 page body incorrectly labels code 132.
fields.Fee Scope: Published group MBA gross schedule includes ₹5,000 security. Code-272 body-label conflict prevents full campus-specific confirmation. Numeric current-fee reference withheld pending a programme-specific fee letter.
fields.Eligibility: Recognised bachelor’s degree of at least three years with 50% General or 45% SC/ST. The 2026 brochure retains UPSEE/CAT/MAT/XAT preference wording; confirm current counselling rules.
fields.Selection Process: CAT/MAT/CMAT/GMAT/XAT/ATMA score, followed by GD/PI. Merit considers academics, work experience, entrance test and GD/PI; no numeric weights.
